title: skins.inventory (platform → server, ephemeral)
description: Proposed by Ready Up (the in-game inventory). One player's items, newest first, as the platform's inventory shows them: the answer to skins.inventory_request and to skins.equip. `enabled` false: skins are off on this platform, or the player has no account (items empty, error says why). team / side: 2 = T, 3 = CT, 0 = both. `side`: the one side that buys the weapon (null: both). `equipped`: the sides it is equipped for. `image`: the game's picture of the item in its wear (panorama/images/econ/default_generated/<image>.vtex), empty when the platform has none.
